title: picea holophylla
intro: Picea holophylla, commonly known as Dahurian spruce, is a species of coniferous tree that belongs to the Pinaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate conditions like arthritis and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Picea holophylla include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
